\caption{Cross sections for inclusive production of positively charged hadrons ($h^+$) in deep-inelastic scattering, for the kinematic region $1500.0 < Q^2 < 20000.0$~GeV$^2$ and $0.021 \leq x < 1.5$, tabulated in bins of the hadron energy fraction $z$ and the hadron transverse momentum $p_{T,h}$. The selection requires $Q^2 > 150$~GeV$^2$; only hadrons within the central tracking region, $|\eta_h| < 1.6$, are included. Each entry is the cross section in nb integrated over the corresponding four-dimensional bin; the bin volume is given in the last column of the table. The bin-averaged density (the cross section divided by the bin volume) is a derived quantity that is deliberately not tabulated, and model predictions must be integrated over the same bin volume before comparison with the tabulated values. The values are Born-level cross sections: they are corrected for detector effects and for radiative (QED and electroweak) effects; the correction convention is photon exchange only, i.e. the cross sections are defined without $Z$-boson exchange. Each cross section is quoted with its statistical uncertainty and its total systematic uncertainty. One correction factor, the applied radiative correction for the photon-exchange-only convention, is tabulated with its uncertainty (sixth column). In this block the physical range of $x$ ends at $x = 1$; the bin volume given in the last column of the table uses this physical limit. The values are preliminary and subject to change.}
